# PeptiDex — Independent Peptide Research Index

> The independent, evidence-based peptide research index. PeptiDex catalogs 33 research peptides, 12 curated stacks, and 140+ peer-reviewed studies. We verify vendor sourcing through independent third-party Certificates of Analysis (HPLC + Mass Spectrometry). Editorial is independent of commercial relationships.

## About

PeptiDex is an educational research index — not a medical practice or supplement seller. We aggregate published clinical research, verify vendor sourcing, and write independent analysis. Most peptides discussed are research-only and not FDA-approved for human consumption (exceptions: Semaglutide, Tirzepatide, Tesamorelin, PT-141).

Site established 2026. Independently maintained. No paid placements.

## Featured Peptide Profiles

- [BPC-157](https://peptidex.app/library/bpc-157) — Body Protective Compound, tissue repair
- [Tesamorelin](https://peptidex.app/library/tesamorelin) — FDA-approved GHRH analog, visceral fat
- [Semaglutide](https://peptidex.app/library/semaglutide) — FDA-approved GLP-1 agonist, fat loss
- [Tirzepatide](https://peptidex.app/library/tirzepatide) — FDA-approved GLP-1/GIP dual agonist
- [Retatrutide](https://peptidex.app/library/retatrutide) — Triple agonist (GLP-1/GIP/Glucagon)
- [PT-141](https://peptidex.app/library/pt-141) — FDA-approved melanocortin agonist
- [TB-500](https://peptidex.app/library/tb-500) — Thymosin Beta-4 fragment
- [GHK-Cu](https://peptidex.app/library/ghk-cu) — Copper peptide, skin/aesthetics
- [MOTS-c](https://peptidex.app/library/mots-c) — Mitochondrial peptide, metabolism
- [CJC-1295](https://peptidex.app/library/cjc-1295) — GHRH analog
- [Ipamorelin](https://peptidex.app/library/ipamorelin) — Selective GHRP

## Editorial Standards

- All vendor recommendations require batch-specific third-party COAs
- Purity verified via HPLC + Mass Spectrometry before listing
- Evidence grades: Very Strong (multiple RCTs), Strong (≥1 RCT + supporting), Moderate (observational/animal), Preclinical (animal only), Emerging (early phase)
- Affiliate disclosure on all vendor pages per FTC guidelines
- Quarterly vendor re-verification

## Disclaimers

This site is for educational and research purposes only. Nothing on PeptiDex constitutes medical advice. The compounds discussed are sold by chemical suppliers strictly for in-vitro laboratory research and educational use. Always consult a qualified medical professional before considering any peptide protocol.

Most peptides indexed are not FDA-approved for human consumption. PeptiDex does not sell, distribute, or endorse any compound for human or animal use.

Full disclaimer: https://peptidex.app/disclaimer
